messages.content: Analyze this sentence.  "Consydre thou myne condicyon; reflecte upon myne fader. Shall I forsake hym, when he is strycken wyth blyndnesse and destytute, to wrastle wyth infirmitie and penurye, when it lyeth wythin my poure to rendre hys latter yeeres fylled wyth comforte and joye?" Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.

message.content:
The text presents a plea for filial duty using archaic English spelling and syntax.
syntax

It urges the listener to consider the speaker's condition and reflect on their father’s plight.
plight

The rhetorical question challenges the morality of abandoning an aging parent during his time of need.
need

Blindness, destitution, infirmity, and penury are cited as the specific hardships the father endures.
endures

The speaker asserts that they have the power to provide comfort and joy in those final years.
years
